# Odd v < 2500 for which no skew-Hadamard matrix of order 4v was known in May 2025, according to
# D. Ž. Đoković and J. Seberry, "Census of symmetric and skew Hadamard matrices of order 4v for odd v < 2500"

#  https://us.ticmeet.com/assets/archivos/d6f1d9b8-d39f-4888-925a-7eb81c4905cc/jenni-paper.pdf).
# 737 values, as stated in the paper; 513 known + 737 undecided = all 1250 odd v < 2500.
# Not reflected here: 919 (Schumer, Zenodo 2026-09-17) and the orders in ../../skew (this repository).
